jobs.title: Product Owner Digital
jobs.description:
In this role, you will help deliver digital products and experiences by translating customer and business needs into actionable requirements and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to support product development efforts, prioritize work, and ensure successful execution throughout the product lifecycle.
We are seeking a product owner who is customer-focused, detail-oriented, and passionate about solving problems. The ideal candidate collaborates effectively across teams, uses data to inform decisions, and can balance multiple priorities while contributing to the delivery of meaningful customer and business outcomes.
- Bachelor's degree in Technology, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 3+ years of experience working on digital products, product delivery, business analysis, or related roles.
- Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and supporting Agile delivery teams.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams.
- Experience using data, customer feedback, and analytics to support product decisions.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Support and enhance the digital customer experience across a specific product, capability, or platform.
- Partner with product managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define user needs, and support product goals.
- Translate business requirements and customer feedback into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
- Manage and maintain the product backlog, ensuring work is prioritized and aligned to roadmap objectives.
- Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and business partners to support day-to-day product delivery.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
- Assist in identifying opportunities to improve customer experiences, workflows, and product capabilities.
- Support the definition and tracking of product metrics to evaluate performance and inform future enhancements.
- Escalate risks, dependencies, and delivery concerns to appropriate stakeholders while helping drive resolution.
- Work closely with technical teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and delivered as intended.
- Leverage customer feedback, research, analytics, and testing results to support product enhancements and prioritization decisions.
- Advocate for the customer while balancing business priorities, technical considerations, and operational needs.
- Stay informed on digital product trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve product delivery.
We are seeking a product owner who is customer-focused, detail-oriented, and passionate about solving problems. The ideal candidate collaborates effectively across teams, uses data to inform decisions, and can balance multiple priorities while contributing to the delivery of meaningful customer and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Product Owner Digital - B2C Search
jobs.description:
The Product Owner, B2C Search supports the development and ongoing improvement of the search capabilities that help customers find the right products on AutoZone.com. This role manages the product backlog, defines requirements, coordinates delivery, and uses customer and performance data to identify opportunities to improve search results.

The Product Owner works closely with Engineering, Analytics, Merchandising, Catalog, User Experience, and Quality Assurance to improve search relevance, ranking, query understanding, internal tools, and platform integrations. The role focuses primarily on search functionality and performance rather than direct ownership of the customer-facing user experience.
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, MIS, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Three to five years of experience in digital product management, eCommerce, search, or a related field.
- Experience managing a product backlog and working with Agile or Scrum delivery teams.
- Ability to write clear user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
- Familiarity with search platforms, search relevance, ranking, filtering, synonyms, boosting, or personalization.
- Experience working with Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, UX, QA, Merchandising, or Catalog teams.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to use data and customer feedback to support product decisions.
- Experience with digital analytics, experimentation, or A/B testing.
- Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate work across teams.
- Familiarity with Vertex AI Search, Elasticsearch, product catalogs, taxonomy, fitment, or search diagnostic tools is preferred.
- Manage and prioritize the search product backlog based on customer needs, business value, platform health, and team capacity.
- Write clear user stories, business requirements, and acceptance criteria for search improvements.
- Support enhancements to search relevance, ranking, query understanding, filtering, synonyms, boosting, and result quality.
- Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop, test, and implement search improvements.
- Support the use and ongoing improvement of search platforms such as Vertex AI Search and Elasticsearch.
- Help develop internal tools for search tuning, rule management, experimentation, diagnostics, and performance monitoring.
- Use search data, customer behavior, logs, feedback, and analytics to identify opportunities and prioritize improvements.
- Monitor key search measures, including engagement, refinements, zero-result searches, conversion, revenue, and performance.
- Coordinate A/B tests and other experiments, document results, and recommend next steps.
- Work with Merchandising, Catalog, Analytics, UX, QA, and other product teams to ensure search supports customer and business needs.
- Support integrations between search and related capabilities such as product recommendations, navigation, content, and catalog systems.
- Assist with troubleshooting search issues and coordinate their resolution with the appropriate teams.
- Communicate priorities, progress, risks, results, and decisions to stakeholders.
- Stay informed about eCommerce search practices and emerging technology that could improve the customer experience.
